sourceBackedAssessment.conclusion: Current ADMITTED FINAL requires recorded cancellation. ObservedPreReadyFailure accumulates SKIPPED/null steps without STARTED or PROGRESS and the coordinator sends FINAL. Preserved three-case XML has two passes/one terminal-completion failure; this review did not rerun it.

Raw validation before projection is required: projection deduplicates indices and fills omissions; current null-origin validation does not reject durationMs alone. Final design expressly requires exact coordinate coverage, SKIPPED, null failure and every timing null.

Binding is immutable and admission receipt is write-once after the actual CAS. Complete JSON equality plus execution/acceptedAt/attempt/admission/runner, accepted revision, test/CSI/principal/environment and deadline equality in the locked SQL predicate prevent a claimed family/runtime flag or mismatched rows from granting the new edge.

Exact outer RUN_ERROR and the ten enumerated inner reasons are source-derived. ERROR/null origin/null duration is terminal accounting only. API error-code mapping stays unchanged; runtime/model provenance remains display data, never report ownership. The ordinary recorded-cancel path remains separate.

Existing transaction/hook, CTE history+ledger update and same-owner/sequence no-write acknowledgement can be reused. The design correctly does not claim payload-hash duplicate detection, and new raw checks precede acknowledgement.

An actual browser/account-apply session can leave a verified recording before Ready reaches the backend. Null reported origin is retained; partiality stays inspection/orderly-close derived. Evidence settlement must preserve the original ERROR and must not invent timing, bytes or a recording.

requiredPositiveOracles.test: Actual joined guided learning/publication -> ordinary admission -> controlled account apply failure -> real owning worker FINAL
assertions: Exactly one genuine observed binding and admission receipt; no fixture bypass of SQL guards.
Committed terminal ERROR; streamComplete true; browserStartedAt and duration null; all immutable source coordinates SKIPPED with every timing/failure null.
Real WebM exists, valid header and >=512bytes, actual upload/inspection disposition, orderly partial=false.
Zero extra application navigations/submissions and zero calls to both model gateways; no account/input canary in persisted/surfaced diagnostics.

requiredPositiveOracles.test: Real pre-Ready prepare and initial-state refusal variants
assertions: Only source-listed fixed reason pairs enter this new edge.
No browser when prepare refuses; keep genuinely available recording for later setup failure without inventing origin.
Failed transaction produces non200 and leaves history/ledger/sequence/evidence/revision unchanged.
Actual same-owner sender retry commits once without another admission, browser or business action.
Same owner/sequence valid duplicate acknowledges applied=false with no rewrite/revision bump.
Subsequent FINALIZING evidence-only settlement preserves ERROR and cannot create STARTED/PASS/readiness.
Older completion cannot overwrite the newer last-run projection.

mutations: Missing or malformed actual admission receipt
requiredNegativeOracles.assertion: No new transition or authority; unknown wire fields remain refused and legacy behavior stays unchanged.
No writes. Use actual negative SQL/schema/admission probes; do not disable immutable triggers to fabricate a positive execution.
The new ADMITTED edge loses its CAS and cannot overwrite the winner. Existing cancellation/RUNNING/terminal handling retains its prior semantics.
Cannot enter failure exception; ERROR/null duration is additionally constrained by SQL. No manufactured application/step execution.

Callback authority remains the existing restricted shared runner-service token and recorded ownership, not per-principal BFF authentication or model provenance.
